Bill.BriefDescription: Zoning exclusively for manufactured housing communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to zoning exclusively for manufactured housingcommunities; adding a new section to chapter 35.63 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 35A.63 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter36.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By July 1, 2004, a city must designate land that is zonedexclusively for the development of newly constructed manufacturedhousing communities as defined in RCW 59.20.030. (2) After the effective date of this act, a city may not designatea new manufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, and maynot order the removal or phased elimination of an existing manufacturedhousing community because of its status as a nonconforming use.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By July 1, 2004, a code city must designate land that is zoned p. 1 SB 5370exclusively for the development of newly constructed manufacturedhousing communities as defined in RCW 59.20.030. (2) After the effective date of this act, a code city may notdesignate a manufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, andmay not order the removal or phased elimination of an existingmanufactured housing community because of its status as a nonconforminguse.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By July 1, 2004, a county must designate land that is zonedexclusively for the development of newly constructed manufacturedhousing communities as defined in RCW 59.20.030. (2) After the effective date of this act, a county may notdesignate a manufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, andmay not order the removal or phased elimination of an existingmanufactured housing community because of its status as a nonconforminguse.
